expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of immune cells (memory/activated T cells, some myeloid cells). It should be common in lymphoid or T-rich areas and absent from tumour or stroma. Cells would be clustered in aggregates or infiltrates, not uniform.
observed: A: yellow is strong in dense patches and sparse in other cores, so it varies from region to region. B and C: only scattered small yellow cells, with most tissue dark. D: ring-like membranous yellow outlines on clustered cells. E: CD45RO lights up in the CD3-dense area, and many cells are white (both) while some CD3 cells are magenta only.
why: Membranous CD45RO is on a clustered subset of cells, in immune-dense areas, and it largely overlaps with CD3 as expected.
